en: Black‑and‑white night view of a richly decorated Baroque palace complex, illuminated against a dark sky. The long façade has tall arched windows and a balustrade lined with statues. At the center stands an ornate pavilion crowned by a large, onion‑shaped dome topped with a crown. In the foreground is a moat or canal crossed by a simple wooden bridge leading toward the palace wall.
